Assign.description: Keys are string indices; each value is a Stage Analysis Control request item (gvs1: SSOT planner).

bLAST_FINAL.description: Last Stage / Other Stage / Stage Combo (OnSet 시 FINAL_STAGE 이름을 FindStagKeyByName으로 역조회. 미존재 시 LV_WRONG_DATA.)

FINAL_STAGE.description: Last Stage / Other Stage / Stage Combo (OnSet 시 FINAL_STAGE 이름을 FindStagKeyByName으로 역조회. 미존재 시 LV_WRONG_DATA.)

RESTART_CS_ANAL.description: Restart Construction Stage Analysis / Select Stages for Restart... (Civil v7.2+ 옵션. 상세 하위 필드는 현재 SSOT에서 요약 수준으로만 제공됨.)

OPT_USE.description: When true, RESTART_STAGE is required; when false, RESTART_STAGE is optional.

RESTART_STAGE.description: Array of construction stage names to restart.

allOf.description: OPT_USE=true then RESTART_STAGE is required
bLAST_FINAL=false then FINAL_STAGE is required
bLAST_FINAL=true then FINAL_STAGE must not be provided

ANAL_TYPE.description: Analysis Type (NL + P-Delta 불가. Geo NL + TDE + Independent 불가)

iINC_NLA.description: Analysis type (Linear: 0, Geometric Nonlinear: 1, Material Nonlinear: 2, Geometric/Material Nonlinear: 3)

bIEMF.description: Include Equilibrium Element Nodal Forces (Geometric Nonlinear + Independent context)

allOf.description: When iINC_NLA is 2 or 3, only iNLA_TYPE=1 is allowed.
bIEMF is allowed only when iINC_NLA=1 and iNLA_TYPE=0.
bINC_PDL is allowed only when iINC_NLA=0.
bINC_TDE is allowed only when iNLA_TYPE=1 and iINC_NLA is 0 or 1.

ERECTION_LOAD.description: (복합) (OnSet 시 LC_NAME_LIST의 각 Load Case 이름을 FindStldKeyByName으로 역조회. 미존재 시 LV_WRONG_DATA.)

EREC.description: Erection Load Type for C.S. (Dead Load:D, Dead Load of Component and Attachments:DC, Dead Load of Wearing Surfaces and Utilities:DW, Earth Pressure:EP, Live Load:L, Wind Load on Structure:W, Temperature:T, Temperature Gradient:TPG, Earthquake:E, Erection Load:ER)

bSDLE.description: Secondary Dead Load Effect for Grid Model

vSDLE.description: Load Case Name List (Grid Analysis Load)

allOf.description: bSDLE=true then vSDLE is required
bSDLE=false then vSDLE must not be provided

TIME_DEP_CONTROL.description: (복합 체크 + 콤보 + 에디트 다수) (Auto Time Step 배열 5개(T>10/100/1K/5K/10K). MEC 전용 Confinement 포함)

TYPE.description: Creep and shrinkage type (Creep:CREEP, Shrinkage:SHRINKAGE, Both:BOTH)

allOf.description: OPT_USE=true then iITS is required
OPT_USE=false then iITS must not be provided

OPT_USE.description: Auto Time Step Generation for Large Time Gap

allOf.description: OPT_USE=true then iT10~iT10K is required
OPT_USE=false then iT10~iT10K must not be provided
OPT_USE=true then TYPE is required
When OPT_USE=false, detail fields must not be provided.
When TYPE=SHRINKAGE, creep-related detail options must not be provided.
bOUCC=true then INTERNAL_STEP, AUTO_TIME_STEP must not be provided

bAPPLY_ELA.description: Apply TDE Elastic Modulus to Post C.S.

allOf.description: bVAR=trueonly when bAPPLY_ELA is allowed
bTTLE_ES=trueonly when iTTLE_ES is allowed

CABLE_CONTROL.description: Internal Force / External Force / Add / Replace

CPFC.description: Cable pretension force type (Internal force:INTERNAL, External force:EXTERNAL)

allOf.description: CPFC=INTERNAL then bEXT_REPL must not be provided

bCONV.description: Convert Final Stage Member Forces to Initial Forces for Post C.S

bCHANGE_CABLE.description: Change Cable Element to Equivalent Truss Element for Post C.S

bAPPLY_IMF.description: Apply Initial Member Force to C.S

allOf.description: bCONV=true then bTRUSS, bBEAM required
bCONV=true then bTRUSS, bBEAM at least one of bTRUSS or bBEAM must be true
When both bTRUSS and bBEAM are false, bCONV must be false.
bCONV=false then bTRUSS, bBEAM not required

INITIAL_DISP.description: (복합) (GROUP 선택 시 GROUP_NAME을 FindGrupKeyByName으로 역조회. Lack-of-Fit Force Control은 M1 DTO 명시 노출 제한 항목.)

OPT_USE.description: Initial Tangent Displacement for Erected Structures (Accumulative context)

ITD.description: Initial tangent displacement type (All structures:ALL, Structure group:GROUP)

GROUP.description: Structure Group Name for ITD (ITD=GROUP when is required)

LFFGR.description: Structure Group Name (LFFC_OPT_USE=true when is required)

allOf.description: When OPT_USE=false, child fields must not be provided.
OPT_USE=true then ITD is required
ITD=ALL then GROUP must not be provided
ITD=GROUP then GROUP is required
LFFC_OPT_USE=true then LFFGR is required
LFFC_OPT_USE=false then LFFGR must not be provided

bCAMBER.description: Apply Camber Displacement to C.S. (if defined)

STRESS_DECREASE.description: Consider Stress Decrease at Transfer Length Zone by Post-tension

OPT_USE.description: Consider Stress Decrease at Transfer Length Zone by Post-Tension

iSDOPT.description: Stress decrease method (Linear interpolation: 0, Constant stress: 1)

SDCONST.description: Ratio Value for Constant Type (iSDOPT=1 when )

allOf.description: OPT_USE=false then iSDOPT, SDCONST must not be provided
OPT_USE=true then iSDOPT is required
iSDOPT=1 then SDCONST is required
iSDOPT=0 then SDCONST must not be provided

bCALC_CSP.description: Calculate Output of Each Part of Composite Section

allOf.description: bSELFCONS is allowed only when bCALC_CSP=true.

INTOUT.description: Intermediate output request (Every increment:EVERY, Last increment only:LAST)

ADVANCED.description: Advanced Nonlinear Parameters (NLCT 의 dlg_api_NLCT_for_planner 의 Advanced Nonlinear Parameters 섹션 참조)

STIFF_UPD_SCHEME.description: Stiffness update scheme (Custom: 0, Full Newton-Raphson: 1, Initial stiffness: 2)

ITER_BEF_UPDATE.description: No. of Iterations before Stiffness Update

MAX_ITER_INCREMENT.description: Max. No. of Iterations per Increment

allOf.description: OPT_USE=true then LINE_SEARCH_TYPE is required
OPT_USE=false then LINE_SEARCH_TYPE, MAX_LN_SRCH_ITER, LN_SEARCH_TOL must not be provided
LINE_SEARCH_TYPE=USER then MAX_LN_SRCH_ITER, LN_SEARCH_TOL is required
LINE_SEARCH_TYPE=AUTO then MAX_LN_SRCH_ITER, LN_SEARCH_TOL must not be provided
When USE_DEF_SETTINGS=true, user-defined fields must not be provided.
When STIFF_UPD_SCHEME = 0, ITER_BEF_UPDATE is required
ITER_BEF_UPDATE can be provided only when STIFF_UPD_SCHEME = 0
When STIFF_UPD_SCHEME != 0, ITER_BEF_UPDATE must not be provided
ENABLE_LINE_SEARCH=false then LINE_SEARCH must not be provided
ENABLE_LINE_SEARCH=true then LINE_SEARCH is required

VALUE.description: Norm tolerance value (required only when OPT_USE=true)

allOf.description: OPT_USE=true then VALUE is required
OPT_USE=false then VALUE must not be provided

VALUE.description: Norm tolerance value (required only when OPT_USE=true)

allOf.description: OPT_USE=true then VALUE is required
OPT_USE=false then VALUE must not be provided

VALUE.description: Norm tolerance value (required only when OPT_USE=true)

allOf.description: OPT_USE=true then VALUE is required
OPT_USE=false then VALUE must not be provided
When iINC_NLA=0 and iNLA_TYPE=0, Initial Displacement, part of Frame Output, and Save OCS are disabled.
iINC_NLA=1 and iNLA_TYPE=0 then Initial Member Force, Initial Displacement, Stress Decrease, Frame Output, Save OCS disabled
iINC_NLA=1 and iNLA_TYPE=1 then Initial Member Force, Stress Decrease disabled
When iINC_NLA is 2 or 3, Cable Pretension, Initial Force/Member Force, Initial Displacement/Camber, Stress Decrease, Frame Output, Save OCS, and Nonlinear Control are disabled.
When iINC_NLA is 0 or 1 and iNLA_TYPE=0, CABLE_CONTROL is not required.
When iINC_NLA is 0 or 1 and iNLA_TYPE=0, if bEXT_REPL is provided inside CABLE_CONTROL, only false is allowed.
iINC_NLA=0 or 1and iNLA_TYPE=1only when CABLE_CONTROL enabled
When iINC_NLA is 0 or 1 and iNLA_TYPE=1 and CPFC=INTERNAL, bEXT_REPL is not required.
Secondary Dead Load Effect is allowed only when iINC_NLA=0 and iNLA_TYPE=1.
bAPPLY_IMF is allowed only when iINC_NLA=0.
ITD_CONTROL is allowed only when iNLA_TYPE=1.
bCALC_CSP is allowed only when iINC_NLA=0 or (iINC_NLA=1 and iNLA_TYPE=1).
bSELFCONS is allowed only when iNLA_TYPE=1, bCALC_CSP=true, and iINC_NLA is 0 or 1.
TIME_DEP_CONTROL is allowed only when bINC_TDE=true.
